matches.rationale: Both identify the same issue: the abstract/introduction claims "less than 1% additional parameters" but Table 1 shows ~1.3% additional trainable parameters in the fine-tuning setting, contradicting the universal claim of <1%.

GT2 concerns the inconsistency in Section 4.2/4.3 about diagonal matrix conditions (ωᵢ ≠ ωⱼ vs. equivalence when equal). Pred_12 addresses a different notation issue (block size vs. number of blocks). No finding matches this specific logical inconsistency.

Both identify that Table 1 data contradicts the prose description in Section 5.1. GT3 describes swapped/exaggerated values; Pred_3 observes the text claims inconsistent improvements and failures that contradict the table's consistent gains.

Both identify missing experimental details in Section 5.2. GT4 notes omission of training budget/compute differences affecting fairness; Pred_7 explicitly quotes the paper admitting extended schedules, augmented compute, and omitted details limiting reproducibility.

Both concern Section 2.3 Related Work reference issues. GT5 describes fabricated/misrepresented citations overstating novelty; Pred_2 identifies a literal "[incorrect ref]" placeholder in the same section, indicating reference integrity problems.

GT6 concerns Table 3 ablation data being exaggerated/swapped to show monotonic improvement with flexibility. No finding specifically addresses manipulated Table 3 values; Pred_9 discusses Table 3 but focuses on Möbius multiplication interpretation, not data integrity.

GT7 concerns overstated rhetoric in the Conclusion ("large margins," "consistently improves"). While Pred_3 and Pred_10 touch on overgeneralization, they focus on specific data contradictions in experiments/abstract, not the Conclusion's rhetorical manipulation.
GT8 concerns omission of ethical discussion/limitations in Conclusion/Acknowledgment. No finding addresses this ethical integrity issue; all findings focus on technical/methodological errors.

GT9 concerns the tension between Sections 4.2 and 4.3 about whether diagonal matrices equal scalar scaling or represent distinct parameterization. No finding captures this specific conceptual incoherence about equivalence conditions.

Both identify vague/incomplete experimental details throughout the Experiments section. GT10 lists learning rates, batch sizes, iterations, integration layers; Pred_7 quotes the paper admitting omission of hyperparameters, training steps, and hardware configurations.
GT11 concerns inflated Table 4 accuracy values for SAM/DINOv2 ablations. No finding specifically addresses Table 4 data integrity; findings discuss other tables (1, 3, 5) but not Table 4.

Both GT12 and Pred_1/4 identify mathematical errors in Appendix theorem derivations. GT12 describes incorrect norm ratios and misapplied hyperbolic identities; Pred_1 notes the flawed Theorem 1 label and internal contradictions; Pred_4 identifies invalid algebraic steps in Eq. (19).

Both concern the Möbius multiplication ablation in Table 3. GT13 notes the corruption removes emphasis on its critical role; Pred_9 observes Section 5.3 dismisses Möbius multiplication as having "limited practical impact" despite Table 3 showing a 0.81-point gap.
